title: Power Round — 2011 — ARML Power sub-problem rubric

criteria.name: Problem 1a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 1a (2 pts). Statement: 1a. For n = 1, 2, 3, 4, and k = 4, ﬁnd Pa(n,n ) + Pa(n + 1,n ) +··· + Pa(n +k,n ).

criteria.name: Problem 1b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 1b (2 pts). Statement: 1b. If Pa(n,n ) + Pa(n + 1,n ) +··· + Pa(n +k,n ) = Pa(m,j ), ﬁnd and justify formulas for m and j in terms of n and k.

criteria.name: Problem 2a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 2a (1 pt). Statement: 2a. Prove that PaP(n, 0) = PaP(n,n ) = 1 for all nonnegative integers n.

criteria.name: Problem 2b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 2b (2 pts). Statement: 2b. Compute rows n = 0 to n = 8 of PaP.

criteria.name: Problem 3a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 3a (2 pts). Statement: 3a. If n = 2j for some nonnegative integer j, and 0 <k <n , show that PaP(n,k ) = 0.

criteria.name: Problem 3b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 3b (2 pts). Statement: 3b. Let j ≥ 0, and suppose n ≥ 2j. Prove that Pa( n,k ) has the same parity as the sum Pa(n− 2j,k − 2j) + Pa(n− 2j,k ), i.e., either both Pa( n,k ) and the given sum are even, or both are odd.

criteria.name: Problem 3c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 3c (2 pts). Statement: 3c. If j is an integer such that 2j≤n< 2j+1, and k <2j, prove that PaP(n,k ) = PaP(n− 2j,k ).

criteria.name: Problem 4a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 4a (2 pts). Statement: 4a. Compute the next three rows of Clark’s Triangle.

criteria.name: Problem 4b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 4b (2 pts). Statement: 4b. If Cl(n, 1) =an2 +bn +c, determine the values of a,b, and c.

criteria.name: Problem 4c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 4c (2 pts). Statement: 4c. Prove the formula you found in 4b.

criteria.name: Problem 5a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 5a (1 pt). Statement: 5a. Compute Cl(11, 2).

criteria.name: Problem 5b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 5b (2 pts). Statement: 5b. Find and justify a formula for Cl( n, 2) in terms of n.

criteria.name: Problem 5c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 5c (1 pt). Statement: 5c. Compute Cl(11, 3).

criteria.name: Problem 5d
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 5d (2 pts). Statement: 5d. Find and justify a formula for Cl( n, 3) in terms of n.

criteria.name: Problem 6
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 6 (3 pts). Statement: 6. Find and prove a closed formula (that is, a formula with a ﬁxed number of terms and no “. . . ”) for Cl(n,k ) in terms of n, k, and the Pa function.

criteria.name: Problem 7a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 7a (1 pt). Statement: 7a. Compute the entries in the next two rows of Leibniz’s Triangle.

criteria.name: Problem 7b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 7b (1 pt). Statement: 7b. Compute Le(17, 1).

criteria.name: Problem 7c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 7c (1 pt). Statement: 7c. Compute Le(17, 2).

criteria.name: Problem 8a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 8a (2 pts). Statement: 8a. Find and justify a formula for Le( n, 1) in terms of n.

criteria.name: Problem 8b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 8b (2 pts). Statement: 8b. Compute 2011∑ n=1 Le(n, 1).

criteria.name: Problem 8c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 8c (2 pts). Statement: 8c. Find and justify a formula for Le( n, 2) in terms of n.

criteria.name: Problem 9a
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 9a (2 pts). Statement: 9a. If ∞∑ i=1 Le(i, 1) = Le(n,k ), determine the values of n and k.

criteria.name: Problem 9b
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 9b (2 pts). Statement: 9b. If ∞∑ i=m Le(i,m ) = Le(n,k ), compute expressions for n and k in terms of m.

criteria.name: Problem 9c
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 9c (2 pts). Statement: 9c. Justify your result in 9b.

criteria.name: Problem 10
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 10 (3 pts). Statement: 10. Find three distinct sets of positive integers {a,b,c,d } with a<b<c<d such that 1 3 = 1 a + 1 b + 1 c + 1 d.

criteria.name: Problem 11
criteria.description: Correct, justified solution to Problem 11 (4 pts). Statement: 11. Find and prove a closed formula (that is, a formula with a ﬁxed number of terms and no “. . . ”) for Le(n,k ) in terms of n, k, and the Pa function.
